integrity: Original proof and finite diagnostic are separated. The published spectral four-cycle representation and classical spherical diameter limit are credited as prior methods; no independent validation or certification is asserted.
limitations: Each n is fixed and delta tends to zero. No growing-n uniformity or extension to other dimensions. Historical priority of evaluated lens constant may overlap uninspected planar motif work.
title: The marked antipodal four-cycle law and the first geometric correction to random spherical diameters
